english.title: Fail to keep required documents in additional vehicle operating under the RSR Protocol
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated an international

(A)_[regular]_
(B)_[special regular]_

passenger service, namely **(..DESCRIBE SERVICE..), by use of an additional vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MAKE AND REG..), and failed to keep in that vehicle the

(C)_[authorisation or a certified true copy thereof to carry out international regular or special regular services and the operator's licence of the operator or a certified true copy thereof for the international carriage of passengers by road]_
(D)_[contract between the organiser and the transport operator or a copy thereof as well as a document evidencing that the passengers constitute a specific category to the exclusion of other passengers for the purposes of the special regular service]_

in breach of Articles 8(9) and 15 of the RSR Protocol
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1)(b) and 18 of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018.
